newsitem.title: USA: Delaware court limits Great Western legal moves.
newsitem.headline: Delaware court limits Great Western legal moves.

text.p: A Delaware judge said Monday Great Western Financial Corp should not rely on arguments that it will incur expenses if it has to change the date of a special meeting of shareholders.

Great Western has not yet set the date for a special meeting to vote on its proposed merger with Washington Mutual Inc. But vice chancellor Jack Jacobs of the Delaware Chancery Court, in a letter to counsel dated May 12, said once the meeting is set, and if rival suitor H.F. Ahmanson and Co seeks an injunction, he will not hear arguments from Great Western on the expense involved in making a change.

Ahmanson is seeking a six-week gap between certification of the results of Great Western's annaul shareholders meeting June 13, at which directors will be elected, and a special meeting to vote on the Washington Mutual merger.
Ahmason has said it believes any directors from the Ahmanson slate that are elected to the Great Western board should have a chance to be heard before a vote on the Washington Mutual transaction.
